scope: One hundred complete October 2022 native card bodies reviewed:97 definitions updated and3 retained. Restore attack/spell/leave-play/ETB dispatch, native Storm query copying, protection, combat AI fields, extra-turn tracking, owner library/graveyard sequencing, single ANYBODY mass actions, token constants, damage bookkeeping, payment guards and native callback/helper delegation. Original source names, APIs, macros and linkage retained without analysis-name aliases. Aligned assembly confirms AI addresses, legend flag and Morality Shift sequencing, including its absent terminator store. Native bytes, DWARF contracts, literal data, 151 source/native enum values, 143 callee/callback identities/prototypes and six complete source dependencies pinned. Independent callee bodies and gameplay remain separately tracked; no generated-byte or whole-program equivalence claim.
